title: Case: Recipient needs a defined delivery slot rather than an all-day estimate
context: A small appliance is booked on an all-day service. Brindleworth must quote available timed slots and confirm the customer’s acceptance of any charge.
initial_request: I cannot stay in all day. Please find out whether there is a two-hour slot and what it costs before changing the service.

events.body: DL-5026 currently has an all-day booking for 2027-02-09. Timed delivery may be available; only scheduling can quote live capacity and the upgrade charge.
I cannot stay in all day. Please find out whether there is a two-hour slot and what it costs before changing the service.
Please quote available two-hour windows for DL-5026 on 2027-02-09, with the total upgrade charge. Do not change the booking until Briony accepts.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Brindleworth, Calloway Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Brindleworth reports the accepted charge; the desk does not set prices or assert payment.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-008: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 3) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
